title: RAG Web Browser
description: Searches the web and returns the top results as clean Markdown, ready to read or feed into a model. Give it a query and it finds pages and extracts their content in one step — the general-purpose 'look something up on the web' tool. Give it URLs instead of a query to just fetch those pages. Free: uses a public search endpoint and your own IP, no API key.

query.description: What to search for. Either this or `urls` is required.

urls.description: Fetch these URLs directly instead of searching.

maxResults.description: How many search results to fetch and convert to Markdown.

maxCharsPerPage.description: Truncate each page's Markdown to this length.

fetchContent.description: Set false to return only search result titles and URLs without fetching the pages. Much faster when you just need links.
